_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fluid_turbulence#3 and a FALSIFICATION of both halves of its Signal. 'DESIGN PERIODIC CONDITIONS' is not a 4C section: it is rejected with "Section 'DESIGN PERIODIC CONDITIONS' is not a valid section name." from 4C_io_input_file.cpp. The real sections are DESIGN LINE PERIODIC BOUNDARY CONDITIONS and DESIGN SURF PERIODIC BOUNDARY CONDITIONS, whose entries pair Master and Slave through a shared ID with PLANE/LAYER/ANGLE. And deleting the real block from the upstream channel deck f3_cha_8x8x8_recongradl2 does not produce 'blockage and incorrect mean flow' -- it aborts with 'Nullspace check for sysmat_ failed' from 4C_fluid_implicit_integration.cpp, because a streamwise-periodic channel has no Dirichlet data in that direction and the pressure nullspace stops matching the Krylov-space projection the deck declares. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).
expect_in_output: Section 'DESIGN PERIODIC CONDITIONS' is not a valid section name.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the naming arm: do not inject the invalid section. The invalid-section-name abort vanishes, so the fixture must go red.
